title: "Maps Plot - All CDK4/6 Inhibitor Comparisons"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---

This notebook creates cancer alliance maps comparing all three CDK4/6 inhibitors: palbociclib, ribociclib, and abemaciclib. Each comparison shows the percentage of one drug relative to the sum of two drugs.

## Load the data

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	warning =  FALSE, message = FALSE
)

require(ggplot2)
require(tidyverse)
require(gtsummary)
require(gt)
require(sf)
require(cowplot)
require(gridExtra)

cdk46Data <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/oph_data_11_25_processed.csv")) |>
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

# agregate the data to VTM & month for ICBs
cdk46Data |>
  group_by(year_month = Date, VTM = `VTM Name`, ICB_name = ICB) |>
  summarise(ddd = sum(Value)) -> cdk46ICBData

head(cdk46ICBData)
```

## Prepare combined data with all three drugs

```{r}
# Extract each drug separately
ribo <- cdk46ICBData |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(VTM == "Ribociclib") |>
  select(-VTM) |> 
  rename(Ribociclib = ddd)

palbo <- cdk46ICBData |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(VTM == "Palbociclib") |>
  select(-VTM) |> 
  rename(Palbociclib = ddd)

abema <- cdk46ICBData |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(VTM == "Abemaciclib") |>
  select(-VTM) |> 
  rename(Abemaciclib = ddd)

# Combine all three drugs
combinedData <- ribo |>
  left_join(palbo) |>
  left_join(abema)

# Replace NA with 0 for all drugs (may not be available in all periods)
combinedData <- combinedData |>
  mutate(
    Ribociclib = replace_na(Ribociclib, 0),
    Palbociclib = replace_na(Palbociclib, 0),
    Abemaciclib = replace_na(Abemaciclib, 0)
  )
```

## Add Cancer Alliance information

```{r}
alliances <- read_csv(here::here("data/CancerAlliances.csv")) |>
  mutate(ICB_upper = toupper(paste("NHS", ICS))) 

combinedData <- combinedData |>
  rename(ICB = ICB_name) |>
  mutate(ICB_upper = toupper(ICB)) |>
  left_join(alliances, by = "ICB_upper") |>
  select(-ICB_upper)
```

## Calculate percentages for each drug pair

```{r}
# Filter to 2020 and 2024 data and aggregate by Cancer Alliance
allianceData <- combinedData |>
  filter(year_month >= as.Date("2020-01-01") & year_month <= as.Date("2024-12-31")) |>
  filter(year_month >= as.Date("2024-01-01") | year_month <= as.Date("2020-12-31")) |>
  mutate(year = year(year_month)) |>
  select(-year_month, -ICB, -Region, -ICS) |>
  group_by(year, Cancer_Alliance) |>
  summarise(across(c(Ribociclib, Palbociclib, Abemaciclib), sum), .groups = "drop")

# Calculate percentages for all 6 comparisons
allianceData <- allianceData |>
  mutate(
    # Ribociclib vs Palbociclib 
    pct_ribo_vs_palbo = 100 * Ribociclib / (Ribociclib + Palbociclib),
    pct_palbo_vs_ribo = 100 * Palbociclib / (Palbociclib + Ribociclib),
    # Abemaciclib vs Palbociclib
    pct_abema_vs_palbo = 100 * Abemaciclib / (Abemaciclib + Palbociclib),
    pct_palbo_vs_abema = 100 * Palbociclib / (Palbociclib + Abemaciclib),
    # Abemaciclib vs Ribociclib
    pct_abema_vs_ribo = 100 * Abemaciclib / (Abemaciclib + Ribociclib),
    pct_ribo_vs_abema = 100 * Ribociclib / (Ribociclib + Abemaciclib)
  )

make_change_table <- function(data, pct_col, new_name) {
  data |>
    select(year, Cancer_Alliance, !!sym(pct_col)) |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = "Cancer_Alliance", names_from = year, values_from = !!sym(pct_col)) |>
    mutate(pct_pt_change = `2024` - `2020`) |>
    rename(
      !!paste0(new_name, "_2020") := `2020`,
      !!paste0(new_name, "_2024") := `2024`,
      !!paste0(new_name, "_change") := pct_pt_change
    )
}

ribo_vs_palbo <- make_change_table(allianceData, "pct_ribo_vs_palbo", "ribo_palbo")
palbo_vs_ribo <- make_change_table(allianceData, "pct_palbo_vs_ribo", "palbo_ribo")
abema_vs_palbo <- make_change_table(allianceData, "pct_abema_vs_palbo", "abema_palbo")
palbo_vs_abema <- make_change_table(allianceData, "pct_palbo_vs_abema", "palbo_abema")
abema_vs_ribo <- make_change_table(allianceData, "pct_abema_vs_ribo", "abema_ribo")
ribo_vs_abema <- make_change_table(allianceData, "pct_ribo_vs_abema", "ribo_abema")

allChanges <- ribo_vs_palbo |>
  left_join(palbo_vs_ribo, by = "Cancer_Alliance") |>
  left_join(abema_vs_palbo, by = "Cancer_Alliance") |>
  left_join(palbo_vs_abema, by = "Cancer_Alliance") |>
  left_join(abema_vs_ribo, by = "Cancer_Alliance") |>
  left_join(ribo_vs_abema, by = "Cancer_Alliance")

allChanges
```

## Load shapefile and join data

```{r}
shp <- read_sf(here::here("data/map/Cancer_Alliances_July_2023_Boundaries/CAL_JUL_2023_EN_BFE.shp"))

mapData <- allChanges |>
  mutate(CAL23NM = str_remove(Cancer_Alliance, " Cancer Alliance")) |>
  mutate(CAL23NM = str_replace(CAL23NM, "Humber, Coast and Vale", "Humber and North Yorkshire")) |>
  mutate(CAL23NM = str_replace(CAL23NM, "RM Partners", "West London")) |>
  select(-Cancer_Alliance)

shp_with_data <- shp |>
  left_join(mapData, by = c("CAL23NM" = "CAL23NM"))
```

## Create map plotting function

```{r}

create_comparison_figure <- function(data, col_2020, col_2024, col_change, pct_label) {
  
  # Scale for change map (right) - dark blue to white to dark red
  change_scale <- scale_fill_gradient2(name = 'Percentage point\nchange', 
                                       low = "#08306b", mid = "white", high = "#67000d",
                                       midpoint = 0,
                                       limits = c(-50, 50))
  
  # Scale for left maps - white to dark blue
  gray_scale <- scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#08306b", 
                                    limits = c(0, 100), 
                                    name = pct_label)
  
  # Change map (main, on the right)
  changeMap <- ggplot(data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[col_change]]), color = "black") +
    change_scale +
    theme_void()
  
  # 2020 map (top left)
  baselineMap <- ggplot(data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[col_2020]]), color = "black") +
    gray_scale +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    ggtitle('2020') +
    theme_void()
  
  # 2024 map (bottom left)
  currentMap <- ggplot(data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[col_2024]]), color = "black") +
    gray_scale +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    ggtitle('2024') +
    theme_void()
  
  # Extract legend for grayscale maps
  legend_plot <- ggplot(data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[col_2020]]), color = "black") +
    gray_scale +
    guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)) +
    theme_void()
  
  gray_legend <- get_legend(legend_plot)
  
  # Layout: 2020/2024 stacked on left with legend, change map on right
  lay <- rbind(c(1,1, 4, 5,5,5),
               c(1,1, 4, 5,5,5),
               c(2,2, 4, 5,5,5),
               c(2,2, 4, 5,5,5))
  
  figure <- grid.arrange(baselineMap, currentMap, gray_legend, changeMap, layout_matrix = lay)
  
  return(figure)
}
```

## Figure 1: Ribociclib % (of Ribo + Palbo)

```{r fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
ribo_palbo_plot <- create_comparison_figure(
  shp_with_data, 
  "ribo_palbo_2020", "ribo_palbo_2024", "ribo_palbo_change",
  "% Ribociclib\n(Ribociclib + Palbociclib)"
)

ribo_palbo_plot
```

## Summary tables

```{r}
# Ribociclib vs Palbociclib
ribo_vs_palbo |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = c("ribo_palbo_2020", "ribo_palbo_2024", "ribo_palbo_change"), decimals = 1) |>
  cols_label(
    ribo_palbo_2020 = "2020 (%)",
    ribo_palbo_2024 = "2024 (%)",
    ribo_palbo_change = "Change (pp)"
  ) |>
  tab_header(title = "Ribociclib % (of Ribociclib + Palbociclib)")
```
